attempts.notes: This is the first form of the FINAL BOSS: make it imposing and richly detailed, clearly grander than any region boss - a towering hooded king of swirling white paper scraps with a wide flaring paper cloak, a jagged folded-paper crown, an empty deep-indigo void inside the hood, huge origami paper hands (the front hand reaching right toward the heroes with long paper fingers), and the sleeping old man half-sunk in the paper vortex of its chest with a small sealing-wax red accent. Big readable light/dark masses; keep the paper bright ivory so it stands out on a dark night background.

variants.prompt: the wind-up pose: the hollow king raises both huge folded-paper hands high on either side, the hood lifted, paper edges peeling. Same size and position.

the WIND-UP pose before it erases names: the hollow king raises both huge folded-paper hands high on either side of the hood, long paper fingers spread, the hood lifted a little, paper scraps of its cloak peeling and lifting upward (still attached to the body). Same design, colours, size and position; the bottom of the cloak stays where it is.
